description: The capability surface of every sample-registry release, as the surface scan computes it over the release's files: the sample packages name no ambient builtin, so every scanned surface is empty. The scan covers source files only; a declared [system.*] capability such as @demo/pyadd's python/interop joins the surface in the lock (cli/tests python suite), not here. A sample package that starts using an ambient builtin must declare it here.
